description: GET /runs/{id}/files restarts stopped sandbox container of terminal runs: run_files.rs reconnect_run_sandbox() calls sandbox.activate() unconditionally; DockerSandbox::activate() docker-starts the container; nothing stops it -> one leaked running container per visited finished run. Same in handler/sandbox.rs list_sandbox_files and sessions.rs. Terminal WS activate is intentional.
resolution: Unresolved; seed fabro-52f2 carries fix options (checkpoint/final_patch for terminal runs, ref-counted auto-stop, or refuse activate on terminal runs; degraded final_patch path already proven viable)

description: GET /api/v1/runs/{id}/files calls reconnect_for_run() + sandbox.activate() (run_files.rs:1216-1220). DockerSandbox::activate() docker-starts a stopped run container (docker.rs:1663, ContainerStartAction::Start) to read workspace files. No production code path in fabro-server calls .stop() afterwards (zero .stop() call sites outside workflow-engine run finalization). Browsing the Files tab of a finished run resurrects its container permanently until manual docker rm or system prune. Observed 2026-08-21: runs 01M0GG56PQYP and 01M0GJVW659C stopped correctly ~1.4s after completion on 2026-08-20 (21:10Z/21:57Z), resurrected 08:04:35Z/08:05:52Z by web UI file inspection, stayed Up ~35min until manual docker rm. Tracked as seed fabro-284b.
resolution: Open: fix directions are (a) serve file listing from checkpoint git storage, (b) stop-after-read when inspection started the container, or (c) idle reaper for containers of terminal-state runs. Seed fabro-284b.
